warnings: control-aug: 12 encoder(s) below the shape gate RETAINED (gate exempt per Amendment A2); near-random recoverability is the baseline datum

report.invariance_rule_primary: two-sided deficit (A10 §c): suppressed iff D = R(random) - R(trained) > epsilon_D; epsilon-invariant iff suppressed at every rung

null_saturation.note: A4: diagnostic only; saturation-excluded flip variants co-reported; no decision rule changes

capacity_axis.measure: trainable parameter count per (rung, factor) (prereg A4c(3))
capacity_axis.note: param-count monotonicity is the frozen capacity-axis check; the ladder's approximate function-class nesting is argued against Lee & Kondor 2026 in the methods; effective DOF is a co-reported diagnostic

epsilon_diagnostics.note: diagnostic only (Q13/D021): adopting a robust epsilon_G requires a dated prereg amendment; G itself is never clipped

h1.rule: Delta_G(F) = G(top) - G(linear); bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 and > epsilon(Delta_G random-vs-random null), with S CI > 0 at the top rung; >=1 factor confirms (prereg §6 H1)

a8e_upper_bias.note: A14 (g): upper bias on Delta_G in the H1-confirming direction. The Adam linear rung underfits the convex solver by this much at the pin; the 4000-step rows close it to ~0.001, so it is an optimizer-budget artifact, bounded, and stated with every Delta_G

h2.rule: paired per-seed Delta_G difference for within-type pairs; Wilcoxon two-sided + bootstrap CI; Holm across pairs x condition cells (prereg §6 H2)

h3.rule: A10 §c PRIMARY: D(F,c) = R(random) - R(trained) > epsilon_D at EVERY rung for >=1 NON-null-saturated factor (A6 gates out saturated readouts — vacuous for want of floor headroom). The frozen one-sided rule (G <= epsilon_G at every rung), its suppressed sub-case and the §6 CI-in-band diagnostic are co-reported as sensitivities (prereg §6 H3 + A6 + A10 §c)

h4.rule: paired G(encoder) - G(projector) > 0 for targeted factors, Wilcoxon one-sided; Holm across targeted factors x rungs x condition cells; strength-widening tested at assembly over >=2 strengths (prereg §6 H4)
